wolf_reference.policy: User-owned T-pose reference inspected read-only; source remains private; generated biped sprites shipped in app

push_up: Four separate character atlases generated directly from user-owned T-pose sheets, background repaired with image_gen; owl wing press is a cartoon adaptation. Four columns/two rows/eight poses per character. Fixed full-cell renderer; ground variation up to five source pixels.
pec_deck: Four reference-based character atlases, 4 columns/2 rows, eight frames each; machine feet registered; owl wings adapted. Generated and background-repaired with image_gen, no expert certification.
cable_fly: Four separate reference-based 4x2 full-body atlases; standing dual cable fly, fixed ground and towers. Owl wings are a cartoon adaptation, no expert certification.
reverse_dumbbell_fly: Four reference-based 4x2 full-body atlases. Seated bent-over variation with two separate dumbbells; owl wing adaptation is a cartoon, not expert technique certification.
face_pull: Four reference-based 4x2 full-body atlases. Single high pulley/two-ended rope pulled toward the sides of the face; owl wings are a cartoon adaptation, not expert technique certification.
shoulder_press: Four reference-based 4x2 full-body atlases. Upright seated machine shoulder press, handles from shoulder level overhead. Owl feather tips with grip straps are a cartoon adaptation, not expert technique certification.
shoulder_dumbbell: Four reference-based 4x2 full-body atlases. Upright seated shoulder press with two independent dumbbells, shoulder-to-overhead progression. Owl feather tips with grip straps are a cartoon adaptation, not expert technique certification.
overhead_barbell: Four reference-based 4x2 full-body atlases. Standing press with one connected barbell. Equal source windows trim only transparent padding and register soles at y390; constant destination across poses. Owl wing tips/grip straps are cartoon adaptation, not expert technique certification.
